title: cerastium alpinum subsp. lanatum
intro: Cerastium alpinum subsp. lanatum, commonly known as Woolly Mouse-ear, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family, Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a variety of health issues, with its health benefits attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Woolly Mouse-ear contribute to its therapeutic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
